title: Your RAG is Unfair: Exposing Fairness Vulnerabilities in Retrieval-Augmented Generation via Backdoor Attacks

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the Target Attack Success Rate (T-ASR) of backdoor attacks that inject stereotypical, toxic, and derogatory language into Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) outputs when processing queries associated with specific religious groups (e.g., Jewish).
Evaluating the probability of generating predefined stereotypical, derogatory, and toxic words in RAG model outputs in response to queries containing female-associated demographic terms.
Assessing the vulnerability of the RAG system to generating derogatory and biased language when triggered by queries containing age-specific target descriptors, such as 'elderly'.

Measuring the attack success rate for inducing racial stereotypes and offensive language in text generation and question-answering tasks targeting specific racial demographic groups (e.g., African Americans).
